Title: TWD - Praxis Seizure Hämeenlinna: Third Tradition

Messages.Author: Jannu
Messages.Body:
Praxis Seizure Hämeenlinna: Third Tradition
Hämeenlinna, Finland
January 18th 2025
2R+F
15 players
Lauri Salmi
www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/12003

Archon approved

15 Metuselahs came to duke it out in Hämeenlinna. Even one old Metuselah rose back to tournament scene after 15 years. Great attendance from Jyväskylä to Helsinki with outstanding participation from Hämeenlinna.

Finalists and decks:
Oko (Banu Haqim bleed&vote g6), Lauri (ANI wall Ravnos/Gangrel g6-7), Marko (Ravnos S&B g7), Peitsa (Banu Haqim bleed&vote g6) and Antti (Tzimisce wall g6).

Game started with Banu Haqims negotiating about which vampires to transfer. After 30 minutes of bleeding and Fisting most of the players were down to ten or less pool. After 40 minutes only Lauri had more than 9 pool. Club illusion and Narrow minds made things even tenser.

At 50 minutes Oko's Warmaksan (Justicar) is torpored. Oko still gets thorugh Iron Fist and gives pool for Marko to stop Lauri's oust. 1:05 there were negotiations of who should be ousted during Peitsa's Iron Fist. As a result Marko was backousted and Lauri gives Peitsa time to take oust from Antti. At 1:15 Antti is ousted by Peitsa.

At 1:30 Peitsa's Fisting with Kassandra Tassiki came to an end as Lauri torporised her. 1:33 Peitsa is ousted and Oko and Lauri are in duel. Lauri has two VP and Oko 0 at this point.

At 1:37 Lauri ousts Oko and Wins the tournament at Hämeenlinna.

Messages.Author: Cerion

Personally I had very much fun playing Animalism combat after a long while thinking

Once again this proves to me, that I should play Combat more often, seems thats the way to win for me. Easiest way to win clearly.
